question: How many days of paid time off do full-time employees receive per year?
expected_answer: 25 days of PTO per calendar year, in addition to public holidays.

question: What is the annual professional development budget per employee?
expected_answer: EUR 2,000 per year; it resets on January 1 and does not carry over.

question: What is the maximum nightly hotel rate for domestic and international travel?
What uptime SLA does the Enterprise tier have?
What was NovaTech's ARR at the end of Q1 2026?
expected_answer: EUR 18.2 million, up 23% year over year from EUR 14.8 million.

question: How quickly must a P1 security incident be acknowledged?
expected_answer: Within 15 minutes of detection; the Incident Response Team must be assembled within 30 minutes.

question: Compare the Professional and Enterprise support tiers.
expected_answer: Professional has support during extended business hours (06:00-22:00 CET, Monday to Friday), email support, live chat during business hours, and a 1 hour response time for critical issues. Enterprise has 24/7 support including live chat and phone, a dedicated support manager, and a 15 minute response time for critical issues.

question: Which CRM was chosen to replace Pipedrive, and how did its cost compare with the alternatives?
expected_answer: HubSpot Enterprise. 3-year TCO: HubSpot EUR 385K, Salesforce EUR 780K, Freshsales EUR 240K (rejected for lacking enterprise capabilities).

question: How is the NovaTech Copilot budget broken down?
expected_answer: EUR 1.2M: personnel EUR 780K, infrastructure EUR 280K, consulting and dataset licensing EUR 90K, contingency EUR 50K.

question: How concentrated is NovaTech's revenue in the Enterprise tier?
expected_answer: 52 Enterprise accounts (6.1% of customers) contribute EUR 2.93M, 61% of revenue; the top 10 customers are 28% of ARR.

question: What requirements apply to employees working remotely?
expected_answer: Internet of at least 25 Mbps down / 5 Mbps up, reachable on Slack and email during core hours, use the company VPN, and work from the registered country; more than 5 consecutive business days abroad needs HR approval.

question: How many days per week can employees work remotely?
expected_answer: The handbook says up to 3 days with manager approval; the March 5, 2026 meeting approved up to 4 days effective Q3 2026, with Tuesday as the mandatory office day.

question: How often must employees rotate their passwords?
expected_answer: The handbook says every 90 days; the March 5, 2026 meeting extended it to 180 days for employee accounts, while infrastructure credentials stay at 90 days.

question: When was ProjectHub v3.2 released?
expected_answer: The documents disagree: the meeting notes say January 28, 2026; the Q1 report says February 12, 2026.

question: What will the Starter tier cost for new customers from Q3 2026?
expected_answer: Not decided yet. It is EUR 29 now; EUR 35, 37 and 39 are being modelled.

expected_answer: The documents do not contain information about contractor remote work policies.
